name: Chilly Beach
description: Chilly Beach is an animated comedy series about life on a floating iceberg in the frozen far north of Canada. Hockey! Beer! Polar bears! Snow!

videos.title: Separation Anxiety
videos.overview: A decades-old debate polarizes the town, and soon Chilly Beach is divided into two ""distinct societies"" based on hockey allegiances: With the demise of Chilly Beach imminent Dale and Frank find a way to work together so they can live to fight another day.

videos.title: Invasion of the Beer Snatchers
videos.overview: Aliens abduct Frank, and after the usual alien probing and prodding, has his brain put under their control.  Dale is single-handedly forced to come up with a solution that will save the Island from both the Aliens and Jacques' exotic poutine recipes.

videos.title: Pucked in the Head
videos.overview: After being hit by a nasty slap shot Frank develops a bad case of amnesia and disappears to parts unknown. Frank is the only one who knows the combination to unlock the town's vaulted beer supply, and unless Dale can get Frank back with his memories intact there could be rioting in the streets of Chilly Beach.

videos.title: Love Potion Undermined
videos.overview: In an effort to gain insight into the mating rituals of Canadians Abby decides to try a pheromone experiment.  Her experiment however goes awry and Abby is left with a bizarre love triangle to clean up before her meddling causes irreparable damage.

videos.title: Shut Your Space Hole
videos.overview: A giant black hole is threatening the planet Earth, and American space scientists need fresh ideas on how to combat it.  Unfortunately, they reject budding Canadian genius Frank who knows that their brilliant plan is only going to make it worse.  Frank has to work fast to stop them before the whole planet suffers the consequences.

videos.title: Power Pray
videos.overview: When coach Jacques goes down with an injury, and can no longer coach the kids pee wee hockey team Dale fills in for a price.  Dale soon finds the deal he made isn't as sweet as he thought and tries everything to sabotage the efforts of the team before realizing what hockey's about.

videos.title: Fever Tale
videos.overview: Katherine is offered a promotion that will take her and Abby back to the United States, but Abby doesn't want to leave. So Abby feigns illness that will put all of America at risk should she be forced to travel back. Her plan backfires and she creates a major epidemic scare.

videos.title: Pity Slickers
videos.overview: In an effort to shore up her fledgling attempts at saving the seals, April seeks the help of a famous celebrity to make her plea heard.  However, when April becomes a less than reluctant media darling in her own right, the real cause becomes lost and Dale and Frank must bring April back from the brink to help her rescue the helpless animals.

videos.title: Angus Rex
videos.overview: A fully intact dinosaur found frozen in the ice under Dale's house thaws out and goes on a rampage through Chilly Beach. Angus is the only one with the skills and equipment to track down and kill the dinosaur and save the town from certain destruction.

videos.title: The Chilly Beachcombers
videos.overview: When Dale misses a never-before-seen episode of his favorite show, ""The Beachcombers"", he hears it will air on Icelandic TV later in the week and devises a zany plan to see it while placing the entire island at risk.

videos.title: Lord of the Ringettes
videos.overview: Dale and Frank's hockey team plays April's team in a game of ringette.

videos.title: The Beer Hunters
videos.overview: Dale attempts to help Frank at the Beer Mart but somehow ends up sending the beer truck, with all of the supplies out into the wilderness.  The townsfolk decide to pursue the truck on a "finders keepers" policy, and during the great chase Frank becomes lost.  Now Dale faces the challenge of winning back Frank's trust by venturing out into an oncoming snow storm to rescue him.

videos.title: Natural Born Curlers
videos.overview: In an effort to find gainful employment, Angus helps Dale with the ice cleaning duties at the rink. With an almost religious obsession, Angus creates the finest curling ice in the world.  When Angus' family from Scotland arrives in Chilly Beach Angus' dad challenges the locals to demonstrate his curling superiority causing Angus to have to choose between his family and his friends.

videos.title: Hollywood Far North
videos.overview: Filming on location in Chilly Beach, the director of a mega-budget Hollywood spectacle decides to blow up the entire island, for dramatic effect.  Dale and Frank have to find a way to re-write this Hollywood ending to save their town from becoming one giant special effect.

videos.title: Secret Santa
videos.overview: While trying to buy a gift for the begrudged annual Secret Santa ritual, Dale stumbles upon none other than Santa (played by Leslie Nielsen) himself.  Santa decides he needs a break and decides to hang with Dale only to become lazy and unmotivated.   With the prospects of Christmas actually happening rapidly diminishing, Santa realizes the error of his ways and with Frank and Dale's help tries to salvage Christmas.

videos.title: Country Cooking
videos.overview: Dale and Frank travel to Ottawa to get support for a petition to allow street hockey on all streets in Canada, but they find out that Chilly Beach is not actually part of Canada. So, they decide to make Chilly Beach its own country.

videos.title: Go Figure
videos.overview: A traveling ice show makes its way to Chilly Beach. Leading it is Elvis Stojko. When they stop into Chilly Beach, no one likes it at all except for Michel, who decides to leave and join the show.

videos.title: Dale to the Chief
videos.overview: The Air Force One makes a pit stop to refuel the plane on Chilly Beach. The President accidentally gets left behind and trys to figure out where in the world he is. Dale becomes friends with the President and soon becomes his adviser, creating international problems

videos.title: Polar Opposites
videos.overview: Chilly Beach becomes the dump site for Toronto's garbage, but with the new dump comes an evil polar bear.

videos.title: Cold War
videos.overview: When two Russian soldiers arrive in Chilly Beach from a drifting iceberg, it takes Dale and Frank shrewd negotiation skills to relieve tensions.

videos.title: The Song Remains So Lame
videos.overview: When Dale and Frank restart their old high school garage band a music producer becomes interested in representing them. Unfortunately she is only interested in Frank.

videos.title: My Big Fat Creep Wedding
videos.overview: Dale steps in as Abby's father at the three legged race at the Father/Daughter picnic. What he did not figure on is that the win might lead to bigger things.

videos.title: Slush Fund
videos.overview: Chilly Beach's tourist trade is dwindling, but Dale and Frank discover a new natural resource that can be exploited for cash.

videos.title: Brother's Day
videos.overview: It's Dale's birthday and he thinks no one remembered. However he gets a surprise when his older more successful brother Dave comes to town.

videos.title: Super Zeroes
videos.overview: Dale and Frank discover that there perks in being "superheroes" but they soon find out that with great power comes great responsibility.

videos.title: Slushbucklers
videos.overview: After the antiques show comes to Chilly Beach Jacques discovers that he is a cursed ancestor of the pirate "Blackboard".

videos.title: Aurora Beerealis
videos.overview: After Dale messes with the northern lights, the whole town becomes hypnotized.

videos.title: Bitter Grounds
videos.overview: Jacques' old friend comes to Chilly Beach and opens up a coffee stand, trying to run him out of business.

videos.title: Full Moon Wiener
videos.overview: Somebody in Chilly Beach (We're not telling who) is bitten by a wiener dog and changes into a cuddly and vicious ankle-biting monster.

videos.title: Polargeist
videos.overview: In the Halloween episode, Dale and Frank are in Dale's house putting up "wrapping paper" when they discover a haunted hockey locker room in Dale's house. Dale gets pulled into the Spirit World where Death mistakes him as someone else. Dale attempts to save his soul by beating Death in a hockey game. Playing the first person to 100. Jacques and Frank try to figure out how to get Dale back.

videos.title: The Souse That Roared
videos.overview: When an object from space falls in Chilly Beach, everyone picks up what they want. Frank takes the plutonium that was in it. The USA thinks that Frank is using it to create Weapons Of Mass Destruction. The US gives Chilly Beach 48 hours to hand over the bomb, so Frank has to create a bomb and hand it over or Chilly Beach will be blown up quicker then Dale drinks a two-four.

videos.title: Chilly Beach We Have A Problem
videos.overview: The US Government needs to get the media off his back because he was caught picking his nose. Katherine gives the government an idea to fake a Pluto landing on the out skirts of Chilly Beach. Frank stumbles upon the "Pluto Landing" site and is mistaken for an alien. Katherine tells Frank that he'll be a part of a "secret" space mission, that no one shall know about. He then figures out the truth later on and Abbie helps Frank escape.

videos.title: The Nature Of Wings
videos.overview: A rare bird has flew in to Chilly Beach and has nestled in the Hockey Rink. David Suzuki declares the the rink a Ecological Site, therefore leaving Dale jobless and able to put the whole town in danger. Dale becomes a lighthouse worker and drives an Oil Tanker into the city creating mayhem.

videos.title: Training Daze
videos.overview: Good news for Frank, his team the Toronto Ptarmigans are training at the rink in Chilly Beach. Unfortunately someone is tampering with the ice because it has frozen trash in it. Dale being the person who keeps the rink the way it is, could he be the one messing the ice up?

videos.title: Winning Freak
videos.overview: Dale gets hooked on energy bars and he enjoys the performance enhancing benefits until he starts to mutate.

videos.title: Not Without My Yeti
videos.overview: Dale and Frank to the rescue after xenophobic Angus captures a Yeti and the Yeti's family comes looking for him.

videos.title: Christmas Inc.
videos.overview: When Frank is appointed as Santa's financial adviser he turns Santa's north pole operation into a capitalist money-grubbing operation.

videos.title: Syruptitious
videos.overview: The boys are upset when maple syrup gets outlawed at Chilly Beach, until Mr. Biggs starts up an illegal maple syrup bar.

videos.title: Canada Joy Land
videos.overview: When a Japanese businessman decides to build a new Canada themed amusement park he hires Dale and Frank as technical consultants.

videos.title: Spiritual Matters
videos.overview: A visiting spiritual leader proclaims Dale as the "great guru". Things get weird until Canadian rocker Lawrence Gowan comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Fortune Kooky
videos.overview: An accidental electric jolt gives Jacques the power to see into the future.

videos.title: Tower of Babble
videos.overview: The popularity of cell phones in Chilly Beach causes the phone company to install a brand new cell phone tower, however the tower attracts killer bees.

videos.title: Hard Time in Chilly Beach
videos.overview: Constable Al throws a bunch of raucous hockey fans into jail, but Frank figures that Team Canada will lose without the fans, so he springs them loose.

videos.title: You've Got Meat
videos.overview: In a crazy love triangle, Jacques is in love with the new female butcher, who is in love with Dale. Sparks fly as Jacques takes on his competition.

videos.title: Bearly Vegan
videos.overview: The Bear decides to give up meat, and everything is going great until he goes through withdrawal.

videos.title: Dr. Dale
videos.overview: When Chilly Beach gets a new TV station Dale stars in his own "Dr. Phil" style advice program.

videos.title: Driving Mr. Biggs
videos.overview: Mr. Biggs is running for election and he hires Dale to help him take on a fast talking competitor.

videos.title: What's Yours is Mined
videos.overview: Angus, Dale, Frank and the Bear are trapped in a mountain cabin with a cache of diamonds. Who will survive the ordeal? Who will get the diamonds? Does anyone trust anyone else?

videos.title: Employee of the Beer
videos.overview: Frank gets to live his dreams when he gets a job in a brewery in Moose Jaw. Unfortunately, all is not as great as he thinks it will be.

videos.title: Lumberjackpalooza
videos.overview: Dale figures he can impress April with his skills in chainsaw tree carving.

videos.title: Love Conquers Al
videos.overview: When Constable Al meets the women of his dreams he is blinded by love, and oblivious to her criminal behavior.

videos.title: Yank My Doodle
videos.overview: Dale adjusts to life in the fat lane after he's granted an honorary American citizenship.

videos.title: How To Succeed in Government Without Really Caring
One Flew Over the Ptarmingan's Nest
The World is Hot Enough
videos.overview: Dale wonders why no one ever visits Chilly Beach, and realizes that it's due to the cold climate. Thus, Frank invents a super heater to warm Chilly Beach up. When the U.S. learns about it, they steal it and accidentally use it to destroy the planet. Frank and Dale must travel back through time to undo the damage.

videos.title: The Canadian President
videos.overview: Dale MacDonald - a not particularly bright ice technician from the northern resort village of Chilly Beach - is chosen to become the puppet president of the United States thanks to the machinations of the shadowy Hangelberg Group and its money-obsessed chairman, known only as The Baron. But when he discovers that The Baron's overarching goal is to hostilely take over his native Canada, doofus Dale must devise a plan to stop them. He enlists the help of his genius friend Frank and a handful of local yokels to sabotage the Hangelbergs' plan to insert satellite-controlled microchips into every Canadian, literally turning them into mindless 'shopaholics'.
